status: APPROVED: the 1004 split with task_049 also excluded as a benchmark defect: 19/20/31 of the 70 valid tasks; 3 samples per task.
METHOD: Family-aware: tasks linked by any family rule (notes pointing at another task, identical golden, golden containment >= 0.5, shared customer by id or by email/phone_number in the scenario with the full name, scenario similarity >= 0.8) form one unit; every unit goes to one set. Units assigned by 120 seeded restarts of size-preserving exchange hill climbing. Objective = mean + max over axes of the worst-arm TVD vs the population, plus 1.0 per task of reward_basis deviation from its proportional quota, plus the anchor cost of moving tasks away from outputs/tau3_split_family_1004/split.json (see 'anchor').
NOT_BALANCED_ON: Measured pass rates, deliberately: no leg, cache or score was read while drawing this split.

anchor.why: Anchor = the approved split 1004: the only intended change is dropping task_049; every other task should keep its set. Same weights as 1004/0925.

floor_anchor_train_now_heldout.what: exact knapsack over the families above: the fewest anchor-train tasks ANY split with these families and train size (and, second row, the train reward_basis quota) must send to val/test

per_task.task_083: ACTION basis. Its 4 golden call_discoverable_agent_tool(file_debit_card_transaction_dispute_6281) calls omit the required argument customer_max_liability_amount (third_party/tau3-bench/src/tau2/domains/banking_knowledge/tools.py:939-958), so each returns 'Error: Invalid arguments ... missing 1 required positional argument'. ACTION compares the arguments string verbatim, so an agent that files the disputes correctly cannot match. Cached episodes: 18/18 matched golden actions 0-5 and never 6-9; 0 passes.
per_task.task_102: The only task with an NL_ASSERTION basis (DB+NL_ASSERTION), so the only reason the rerun would need a judge model. Its assertion requires 'recognizing that Ember Analytics exceeds the 4-year company age limit'; Ember's real age (5 years) is only in the task notes, absent from initial_state, db.json and all documents (grep 'Ember' finds nothing), and the simulated user says 'about 3 years'. Across cached legs the judge answered met=True 11 times in 90 judged episodes, 9 of whose justifications describe a failure.
